test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)

question: In a certain code language, 'FIELD' is written as 'LOKRJ' and 'GLOBE' is written as 'MRUHK'. How will 'GLASS' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2279c21b248cf244ce9c66a353413ffa1a01afa396a02423895bd343ac1e758.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd36aa286059ba097a54988968188cfce9f1a49cdd81094fe42b69f65eb2e737.png] 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e8d81c5be4fa1ac61564aa2ba6c1bb3b7a59373b0086222ba4db2ff266c5f3.png] 

Similarly,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ed0f891d69fdb41bde3f9f1263c28f129d8bf5b73ccaff1ff2501d5f77f1e0f.png] 

Hence, '**MRGYY**' is the correct answer.
